module origen_199381(
    input clock,
    input reset,
    input request,
    input blocked,
    output red,
    output green,
    output waiting
);

`ifdef FORMAL
    parameter GREEN_PERIOD = 5;
`else
    parameter GREEN_PERIOD = 10000;
`endif

    reg [7:0] state;
    reg [31:0] counter;

    localparam STATE_IDLE = 8'b00000001;
    localparam STATE_WAIT = 8'b00000010;
    localparam STATE_GREEN = 8'b00000100;

    always @(posedge clock or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            state <= STATE_IDLE;
            counter <= GREEN_PERIOD;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                STATE_IDLE: begin
                    if (request) begin
                        state <= STATE_WAIT;
                    end
                end
                STATE_WAIT: begin
                    if (!blocked) begin
                        state <= STATE_GREEN;
                    end
                end
                STATE_GREEN: begin
                    if (counter == 0) begin
                        state <= STATE_IDLE;
                        counter <= GREEN_PERIOD;
                    end else begin
                        counter <= counter - 1;
                    end
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

    assign waiting = (state == STATE_WAIT);
    assign green = (state == STATE_GREEN);
    assign red = !green;

endmodule
